propositions: Author a project-owned code-review criterion `project.review-phase-boundaries` with four co-located subrules enforcing strict phase boundaries: Pass 1 discovers findings only without assessment, Pass 2 verifies atomically without discovery, Pass 3 applies deterministic thresholds without LLM judgment, Pass 4 coaches non-prescriptively without re-adjudication.

The criterion prompt must route with `block_threshold: 0.90`, `blocking_enabled: false`, `exec: 1-TURN`, and `execution_mode: single_turn`, emit grounded evidence findings without severity/confidence/suggested_fix fields, and include guards that distinguish operative instructions from documentation and abstain when phase ownership is unclear.

A balanced twelve-case eval corpus (RP-F1..RP-F6 must fire; RP-N1..RP-N6 must not fire) must achieve recall 1.0, false-accept 0.0, agreement 1.0, minimum per-case stability ≥2/3, and Cohen kappa ≥0.70 across three live runs with model, timestamp, and all 36 executions recorded on the ticket.

Implementation must be entirely project-owned: changes only `.rebar/` prompt/routing/eval assets, `.gitignore` exceptions, criterion-specific tests, and a new `Project dogfood: review-phase-boundaries` subsection in `docs/llm-framework.md`, with no modifications to kernel integration seam, generic dependencies, or blocking behavior.

Predecessor dependency `41e2-a0a2-2db4-4847` (CLI-admission seam) must be landed first and supplies prompt-id resolution, Round-A fan-in, Pass-3 repository routing, and gate-aware calibration; this story uses those generic extension points without adding core special cases.

Committed implementation must land on `main` with operator-attested live calibration evidence showing all RP-F cases fired and all RP-N cases abstained across three runs, achieving perfect metrics (recall/false-accept/agreement/kappa all 1.0).
